scope_note: Research qualification candidates only. Complete disclosed scopes and admitted parser scopes are separate; complete_edition_claim false is deliberate for bounded scope observations.

profiles.scope: 2025 House and Senate publisher-issued downloadable scorecards, including every published member/rating/item cell.
proof: Publisher download links label the year and chamber. Valid XLSX ZIP has one worksheet and declared dimension; every worksheet row has the expected width.
House worksheet A1:S439 gives 438 member rows and 13 item columns; Senate A1:N103 gives 102 and 9. Separate HTML item lists reconcile exactly to 13 and 9; all 22 linked item pages captured.
Annual and lifetime cells are text percentages. Worksheet preserves 6612 member-item cells, including all blank cells and source glyphs.
limits: Item-page member tables show only the first page; member outcomes are taken from complete downloadable workbooks, not these partial page tables.
No numeric interpretation is assigned to blank, circle or check cells without publisher legend context.
A source note explains that its letter item uses no-vote encoding for signed letters and that its passed/failed notation does not apply.
Lifetime underlying historical items are outside the 2025 workbook; lifetime published values can be retained without score reproduction.
The duplicated H.R.4 workbook columns have no proven linkage to the two dated item URLs. Production member-item mapping must establish a unique source-backed crosswalk or refuse that scope.

profiles.scope: Complete current publisher export for session_year=2025 with include_former=1, both chambers; complete offered 2025 item index.
proof: Export action was derived from publisher form fields and public JavaScript. Both chamber requests return identical two-chamber CSVs.

All 551 distinct member URLs reconcile to all 551 HTML cards; annual/lifetime cells agree under explicit representation-only cross-checks for trailing percent sign and na/N/A. No transformed value is substituted into source observations.
CSV sections contain 103 Senate and 448 House rows; item export contains 34 Senate and 32 House rows. Complete official 96-page PDF also retained privately.
limits: Scope is the publisher current response to a 2025 request, not an inferred historical roster. Three listed members have blank annual cells and lifetime na: Alan Armstrong, Clay Fuller and Analilia Mejia.
Do not create a nonblank annual rating for an empty cell. Member presence is independently retained.
CSV values are bare strings; HTML percentages and na/N/A are separate source representations.
Whole member-item PDF grid is captured but not parsed or qualified. A complete item-result reader needs separate qualification.
CSV is recommended authoritative rendition for V1 ratings; source unit context is retained separately.

profiles.scope: Complete published 2025 House and Senate grade tables and disclosed scored-vote list.
proof: Both complete named HTML tables contain 100 Senate and 431 House rows.
All 531 name/state/district/grade rows exactly reconcile to the official 13-page downloadable PDF. All PDF table regions were read, not only sample cells.
Two-page vote supplement lists six House and six Senate vote references with publisher positions.
limits: Published ratings do not disclose all leadership/accessibility/committee contributions. Their absence prevents reproduction, not grade retention.
Literal state NES for Pete Ricketts occurs in both renditions and must remain unchanged.
The amendment item names S.Amdt.2382 to S.Amdt.2360 to H.R.1; preserve multiple references rather than selecting one arbitrarily.

profiles.scope: Complete Senate chart in the final 2025 edition, with disclosed Senate item and leader columns.
proof: The complete final PDF is 20 pages. Senate method is physical page5 and the entire Senate chart occupies pages6–8 before the next section.
Parsed all 100 unique member rows, source state headings and both action columns; every source state contains two listed senators.
Rendered pages6–7 confirm the extracted table layout and legend. Preserve raw PDF glyph tokens ü and ê as well as rendered check/star meaning.
Score column includes numeric strings, 100+ and ••. The legend expressly states •• means top leaders have no numerical score.
limits: House grid and historical PDF layouts remain unqualified for extraction. Select for adapter implementation, but require complete House qualification before enabling any whole-edition replacement; no runtime chamber scope is assumed.
Leader is an aggregate activity indicator; a star does not establish an exact numeric bonus or disclose all contributing actions.
Raw empty cells remain empty, not inferred negative actions.

profiles.scope: Observed current 119th member ratings and every item returned by the public current-edition catalogs.
proof: Key-vote response declares total20, last_page1, nextnull, and contains20 rows. Every listed vote detail was captured.

Cosponsorship response is an unpaginated data list of8 entries, below the public app requested limit25. Every listed detail was captured. This is an observed public-list scope, not an independent proof of unlisted publisher items.
All three catalogs repeat identically at the data level after detail capture. All28 details identify Congress119.
All item member groups have unique IDs per item; 8780 member-item rows cover544 people. Every live-list member is represented, and all repeated API score values agree.
Current live roster has531 members; complete item groups also include13 former members. Preserve the union and source provenance.
limits: API null and HTML N/A are different literal score representations for four live members.
The historical /scorecard/members/118 page declares118 but embeds current members. Reject historical full-edition snapshots from that route.
Historical exact-item responses remain valid challenge observations and must not be elevated to a historical edition replacement.
This is an observed crawl. It cannot prove historical completeness or an immutable publisher version.

proof: Current How They Voted index was captured and contains introductory text and methodology link but no member rating table or downloadable member dataset.
A historical indexed sample PDF route returns404. This is retained as failure, not an empty scorecard.
limits: No complete member/component dataset was found in the bounded pass. Keep composite-method shape in V1 and explicitly defer production ingestion.
Methodology pages differ in detail: current method describes leadership relative to party peers. Pin source/version; do not merge it silently with the older example.
